name: report-subscriptions
description: CSA Loom report-subscriptions delivery runtime (WS-C2) — scheduled in-VNet Container App Job. On its cron it reads enabled report subscriptions from Cosmos, selects the ones whose own NCRONTAB cron is due, renders each report Azure-native (paginated-report-renderer — no Power BI ExportTo / Fabric dependency), POSTs the rendered bytes to the delivery Logic App (Office 365 email), and writes an append-only ReportDeliveryLog row the [subId]/logs route surfaces. Managed-identity auth, no keys. NOT a Y1 Function: this estate's Linux Consumption plan cannot reach its AAD-only storage data-plane, so the ACA-job pattern (secret-expiry-monitor / lineage-extractor) is used.
